churn_resistance.rationale: Data access is behind one well-typed module and components take data via props, which upgrades would touch little — but the caching model (segment configs in every route plus a hand-rolled cache) is the one place framework movement ripples across nearly every file.

findings.issue: The app runs on the previous-generation caching model: `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`, `revalidate = 0` and `fetchCache = 'force-no-store'`, copy-pasted into 8 route files. Next 16 removes these when Cache Components is enabled and the migration guide replaces them with `use cache`/`cacheLife`; the settings are also mutually redundant since Next 15+ already leaves fetch uncached.
findings.suggestion: Enable `cacheComponents: true` + `partialPrefetching: true` in next.config.mjs and declare caching once via `use cache`/`cacheLife` in lib/api.ts; at minimum, drop the per-page copies and the redundant `revalidate`/`fetchCache` exports (the root layout already covers the tree).

findings.issue: Hand-rolled module-level promise cache with no TTL/invalidation replaces framework caching primitives, duplicating a concern the framework owns and adding code a Cache Components migration must rewrite.
findings.suggestion: Let the framework own caching (`use cache` + `cacheLife`, or React's `cache()` for request-scoped dedupe) instead of a global Map.

findings.issue: Pagination uses plain `<a href>` links, causing full page reloads and losing `next/link` prefetching/client transitions, in a client component that already has the router available.
findings.suggestion: Use `<Link href={hrefFor(n)}>` for the Previous/Next page links.

findings.issue: Unknown resources render `<NotFoundContent/>` inline with HTTP 200 instead of calling `notFound()`; the same pattern repeats on the move, ability and type pages, so a future 404-status requirement touches five files.
findings.suggestion: Call `notFound()` from 'next/navigation' and let the existing `app/not-found.tsx` boundary render, which also sets the 404 status.

findings.issue: Server-side fetches have no `AbortController` or timeout; a slow API hangs the page render indefinitely (Node fetch has no default timeout).
findings.suggestion: Add an AbortSignal.timeout() (or a signal with a sane duration) to each request.

findings.issue: `idFromUrl` regex-parses resource URLs by hand where the platform's URL API is the right tool and more robust against trailing-slash variations.
Two different URL-state mechanisms coexist: raw `window.history.replaceState` here vs `router.replace(..., { scroll: false })` in MovesSection.tsx:104 — the next maintainer has to know both idioms.
findings.suggestion: Standardize on one documented pattern (e.g. router.replace everywhere, or extract a small useUrlState hook in lib).

findings.issue: `first()` searchParams helper is duplicated verbatim in app/app/pokemon/[name]/page.tsx:36-39.
findings.suggestion: Move it into lib/format.ts (or a shared searchParams module).

findings.issue: The root .gitignore only covers /data/, /.data-cache/ and node_modules/; `app/.next/` (build artifacts) and `app/next-env.d.ts` sit in the working tree unignored, risking build output being committed.

Plain `` with manual `loading="lazy"`/width/height instead of `next/image`; defensible because the image origin comes from `API_BASE_URL` at runtime (remotePatterns is build-time), but the choice is implicit.
findings.suggestion: Either document the deliberate plain- choice in lib/api.ts, or use `next/image` with `unoptimized` to get consistent sizing behavior.

summary: A lean, current-dependency Next.js 16.4.3 App Router app: async request APIs, typed data access centralized in one module, and only three runtime packages. Its forward-looking weakness is that it commits fully to the previous-generation caching model — copy-pasted `dynamic`/`revalidate`/`fetchCache` route configs in every route plus a hand-rolled in-memory cache — exactly the layer Next.js 16.4's Cache Components model and the Next 17 default are slated to replace. Secondary idiom misses (plain `<a>` pagination, inline not-found rendering instead of `notFound()`) add churn but are localized.

apis.replacement: Cache Components (`cacheComponents: true` + `partialPrefetching: true`) with `use cache`/`cacheLife`; these segment configs are removed when Cache Components is enabled (route-segment-config docs, v16.0.0)
